title: Furnishing Timetable in Business Days — Good Faith & Price Estimates
content:
All Good Faith & Price Estimates deadlines are counted in business days, and a business day is Monday through Friday, excluding federal holidays. The same calendar applies to every estimate type.

## Timetable by estimate type (business days)

| Estimate type | Minimum scheduling lead at or above which a good faith estimate must be furnished before the service | Furnished within, after the scheduling date, when scheduled at least 3 but fewer than 10 business days ahead | Furnished within, after the scheduling date, when scheduled at least 10 business days ahead | Furnished within, after an unscheduled request | Insured out-of-pocket estimate furnished within, after the request | Revised estimate furnished no later than this many business days before the scheduled service | Time a co-provider has to send its expected charges to Riverbend as convening provider |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Single Scheduled Service | 3 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Procedure with Co-Providers | 3 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Recurring Course of Care | 3 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate | 3 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Imaging & Diagnostics | 3 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery | 3 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery | 3 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |

Business-day calendar on every type: Monday through Friday, excluding federal holidays.

## Worked readings (hypothetical dates, no federal holiday in the span)

- A service booked on a Monday for a date 12 business days later is scheduled at least 10 business days ahead: the column value is 3 business days after the scheduling date.
- A service booked on a Monday for a date 5 business days later is scheduled at least 3 but fewer than 10 business days ahead: the column value is 1 business day after the scheduling date.
- A Friday followed by a federal holiday Monday: the Monday is not counted, so the first business day after that Friday is the Tuesday.
